# `essential_contacts_organization` — version 1.3 · content pack

Source: `presets/essential-contacts-organization.satz` — a **content** pack: forking it into `<name>.local.satz` is the expected workflow (per-customer content).

## Purpose

One organization-level Essential Contact, subscribed to every notification
category Google routes.

One address may appear ONCE per parent — so the shipped shape is a single
contact on ALL. To split by audience (billing to finance, suspension and
security to the on-call, …), uncomment the per-category contacts below,
give each its own address, and either narrow or delete the `all` contact:
an address subscribed to ALL already receives every category.

Categories (API enum names): BILLING, LEGAL, PRODUCT_UPDATES, SECURITY,
SUSPENSION, TECHNICAL — and ALL.

## Use it

```
params {
  // the pack's own defaults — copy only the lines you change
  essential_contacts_email = "essential-contacts-all@{customer_domain}"
}

google_essential_contacts_contact { use "presets/essential-contacts-organization.satz" }
```

**Needs from outside the pack:**

- `customer_domain` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.
- `customer_organization_id` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.

## Questions

What to ask before this pack is configured, and what changing the answer costs.

| asks about | prompt | reversal | blast | recommends |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `essential_contacts_email` | The address that receives every Google notification for the organisation (a group, never a person) | edit | high | — |

**essential_contacts_email** — Suspension notices, security advisories and legal notices go here and nowhere else. The mailbox must exist and accept external mail; a wrong address means Google's warnings are read by nobody until the consequence arrives.

## Notes

<!-- notes:start — hand-written, kept across `satz doc-packs` -->

One address may appear only ONCE per parent, which is why the shipped shape is a single contact on ALL categories. Splitting by audience needs a distinct address per category — the six per-category contacts are shipped commented out for exactly that.

The CIS pack's contact-domain policy must allow the address's domain, or the apply is refused by the policy this estate itself set.
